create_StreamId_from_numeric_name: create a StreamId object from a numeric name string like '214-1' for RGB camera streams
create_StreamId_from_type_and_instance: create a StreamId object from a recordable type ID and instance ID integer pair
get_StreamId_name_and_type: get the name and type name of a StreamId object using get_name and get_type_name methods
check_StreamId_validity: check if a StreamId object is valid using the is_valid method
use_RecordableTypeId_enum_values: use RecordableTypeId enum values like SLAM_CAMERA_DATA or STEREO_AUDIO_RECORDABLE_CLASS to identify sensor stream types
